name: Bathin
source:
Oddly enough, he is from Paradise Lost where Lucifer is king.

He is quiet but free, and is always ranked in the high ranks when there is a Most Handsome Devil contest within Hell.

He is very quiet and seems to mostly listen to Stolas complain, but he is better at fighting than Stolas.
